output.review_comment: The special-case logic for exactly 6-row floors (lines 46-48) appears to be test-specific rather than implementing a general algorithm. Why would dock-to-pick-face routing require hardcoded special handling for exactly 6 rows? This needs either: (1) a clear explanation in a code comment about why this warehouse layout requires special handling, or (2) removal in favor of the general BFS solution. Also, the behavior change from returning None to returning -1 for unreachable destinations should be documented in a PR description.
